name: simple_fsm_bench_long_text
description: A synthetic benchmark that tests models' ability to simulate finite-state machines (FSMs) over long input texts, emphasizing long-range state tracking and memory. Tasks present long sequences where the model must determine FSM acceptance or the correct resulting state after processing the sequence. It is intended to probe sequence-processing and internal state maintenance capabilities of language models.
reputation: A small, specialized synthetic benchmark used in research on model memory and state-tracking with limited adoption outside the focused research community.
